import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    T = int(next(it))
    a.sort()
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n):
        p = i + 1
        while p < n and a[p] - a[i] <= T:
            p += 1
        ans = max(ans, p - i)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
